usdcExplainer.heading: About USDC
usdcExplainer.body: USDC is a USD-pegged digital asset held in your Algorand wallet. It is not automatically convertible to local currency. Options for accessing value include: holding as digital treasury, peer-to-peer exchange, or overseas exchange via international bank account. SBP is consulting with the Central Bank of Samoa on the regulatory pathway.

path.prompt: How will you access your wallet?

smartphoneSteps.step1_body: Free. Available on iPhone and Android.
smartphoneSteps.step2_body: Open Pera, tap "Create Account", follow the steps.
smartphoneSteps.step3_title: Step 3: Add USDC to your wallet
smartphoneSteps.step3_body: In Pera: tap the + button, search "USDC", then Add.
smartphoneSteps.step4_title: Step 4: Paste your wallet address below
smartphoneSteps.step4_body: In Pera: tap your account name, tap the address to copy it, then paste it in the field below.

computerSteps.step1_body: Lute is a free browser extension for Chrome.
computerSteps.step2_body: Open Lute, click "New Account", follow the steps.
computerSteps.step3_title: Step 3: Add USDC to your wallet
computerSteps.step3_body: In Lute: click Assets, Add Asset, search "USDC", then Add.
computerSteps.step4_title: Step 4: Paste your wallet address below
computerSteps.step4_body: In Lute: click your account name, copy the address, then paste it in the field below.

security.title: Keeping your wallet secure
security.note: Your 25-word backup is the only way to recover your wallet. Store it offline — written on paper in a secure location. Never store it digitally or share it with anyone.

rocca.note: Simpler wallets are coming. Algorand is developing a new wallet called Rocca — designed to work like a normal app, with no backup words required. PDC will support Rocca when it becomes available. Your current wallet address will work seamlessly — no re-registration needed.

usdcReality.heading: About receiving USDC payments
usdcReality.body: Your earnings will be paid in USDC, a USD-pegged digital currency, directly to your Algorand wallet. USDC is not the same as cash in a bank account. Options for accessing value from your USDC: hold as a digital treasury asset, peer-to-peer exchange with contacts who hold USDC, or through an international exchange if your institution has a foreign bank account. Synergy Blockchain Pacific is actively consulting with the Central Bank of Samoa on a formal USDC-to-WST conversion pathway. We will notify all providers when this pathway becomes available.
